description: This file defines the `GatewayDeviceAuthPayload` enum with static methods related to building device authentication payloads, normalizing metadata fields, and generating signed device dictionaries, primarily for device authentication purposes within a protocol or SDK.

methods.name: buildV3
methods.description: Constructs a version 3 device authentication payload string from device info, scopes, and other metadata.

methods.name: normalizeMetadataField
methods.description: Normalizes a string metadata field by trimming whitespace and converting uppercase ASCII letters to lowercase.

methods.name: signedDeviceDictionary
methods.description: Generates a dictionary with signed device information, including cryptographic signature, for device authentication.
